div.head: Had 1.1
div.ab: 7 eallum Godes freondum gebyreþ swyþe rihte, þæt hi Godes cyrcan lufian 7 wurþian 7 Godes þeowas friðian 7 griþian.
Et omnibus amicis Dei recte pertinet, ut sanctam ecclesiam diligant et honorent et Dei ministros pacificare et defendere (custodire) gaudeant.
And eallum Godes freondum gebirað swiðe rihte, þæt hi Godes cirican lufian 7 wurðian 7 Godes þeowas friðian 7 nerian.
And to all friends of God it belongs rightly that they love and honour God's church and protect and defend God's servants.
And very rightly, it is proper for all friends of God that they love God's Church and venerate it, and preserve and protect God's servants.
Und für alle Freunde Gottes gebührt sich sehr ordentlich, dass sie Gottes Kirche lieben und ehren und die Gottesdiener in Frieden schirmen und schützen (mit Sonderschutz umgeben H).
And it is very right for all God's friends that they love and honour God's church, and shelter God's servants in peace and protect them (surround them with special protection, H).
div.note: H's ‘hi’ was altered to ‘hy’. K: a double space removed. Liebermann compares I Cn 4.
